name: Virgin River
description: After seeing an ad for a midwife, a recently divorced big-city nurse moves to the redwood forests of California, where she meets an intriguing man.

videos.title: Carry On
videos.overview: When nurse practitioner Mel moves to a remote town in northern California looking for a new life, she's startled by the welcome she receives.

videos.title: Lost
videos.overview: After finding an abandoned baby on Doc Mullins's doorstep, Mel and her boss argue over whether to call Social Services or find the newborn's mother.

videos.title: ... and Found
videos.overview: Mel considers being a temporary foster parent to Chloe while grappling with her own grief. Jack works to convince her to stay in Virgin River.

videos.title: A Wounded Heart
videos.overview: Hope's health scare prompts a difficult conversation with Doc. Charmaine asks Mel uncomfortable questions. Paige keeps secrets.

videos.title: Under Fire
videos.overview: Under pressure, Mel and Jack respond to a medical emergency on a remote illegal pot farm. Charmaine and Hope exchange words.

videos.title: Let's Mingle
videos.overview: Mel gets a surprise visitor just in time for the town's big dance party. Jack continues to suffer flashbacks from his time in the military.

videos.title: If Truth Be Told
videos.overview: Preacher happens upon a secret. Mel's memories threaten to overwhelm her. Jack has a sincere talk with Charmaine about their relationship.

videos.title: Into the Light
videos.overview: A storm causes a town power outage and everybody gets together at Jack's bar. Mel grapples with her revelation. Preacher investigates Paige.

videos.title: Everybody Has a Secret
videos.overview: Hope urges Jack to read Charmaine's letter. Preacher confronts Paige with his new knowledge. Mel and Doc work together on a pressing case.

videos.title: Unexpected Endings
videos.overview: Charmaine tells a stunned Jack to make a decision while Mel is left reeling and Hope is filled with guilt. Meanwhile, Paige opens up to Preacher.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Jack asks Mel for help when Charmaine experiences a complication in her pregnancy. Hope insists that Doc keep their relationship a secret.

videos.title: Taken by Surprise
videos.overview: Despite Mel's efforts, Charmaine's stay at Hope's house gets off to a rocky start. A situation involving Paige's past intensifies unexpectedly.

videos.title: The Morning After
videos.overview: Mel endeavors to help an uncooperative Charmaine get hydrated while thinking about what transpired with Jack. Calvin offers Brady a new job.

videos.title: Rumor Has It
videos.overview: The town attends the annual picnic where residents engage in friendly competition, romantic tiffs and —as far as Mel is concerned — too much gossip

videos.title: Can't Let Go
videos.overview: Jack's war memories haunt him when he reunites with his Marine friends. Mel struggles to handle conflict with her sister-in-law.

videos.title: Out of the Past
videos.overview: Mel grapples with how to honor Mark ahead of the anniversary of his death. Jack's stress leads him to bad decisions. Hope apologizes with pie.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: When police find a body in the woods, Preacher worries about the implications. Charmaine and Jack work on a birth plan with Mel.

videos.title: Blindspots
videos.overview: While Jack helps Mike zero in on Calvin, Mel and Doc investigate a mysterious outbreak that could be related to food poisoning. Hope learns a secret.

videos.title: Hazards Ahead
videos.overview: Mel searches desperately for Jack, who has stumbled upon disturbing news. Jamie makes Preacher an enticing job offer. Hope questions Doc's loyalty.

videos.title: Blown Away
videos.overview: Mel tracks down Brady to find out more about Spencer. Hope answers Doc's question. Preacher makes a life-changing decision.

videos.title: Where There's Smoke...
videos.overview: Mel attempts to avoid celebrating her birthday while remembering the past. Doc confirms his troubling diagnosis and begins looking for his replacement.

videos.title: Sticky Feet
videos.overview: Ricky and Lizzie struggle to find privacy. Doc worries about Hope, who may be stuck in a hurricane. Mel offers Jack an enticing invitation.

videos.title: Spare Parts and Broken Hearts
videos.overview: Lily divulges a devastating secret to Mel. Brie gets to know Brady better and admits something to Jack. Lizzie's ex surprises her.

videos.title: Take My Breath Away
videos.overview: Doc and Mel help Christopher and Preacher with a medical emergency. After an angry confrontation, Jack focuses his energy on a romantic gesture.

videos.title: Kindling
videos.overview: Mel is taken aback by Doc's news after they interview a new doctor. To Jack's chagrin, Todd makes a bold request. Lily makes a difficult revelation.

videos.title: Jack and Jill
videos.overview: Jack and Mel argue about their relationship and their future while competing in the Lumberjack Games. Brie opens up about her painful breakup.

videos.title: Split
videos.overview: Jack meets with a custody attorney and his stress begins to overwhelm him. Brady gets brought in for questioning. Muriel offers Doc advice.

videos.title: Life and Death
videos.overview: Heartbroken, Mel heads to LA to support Joey at her divorce hearing. More of Jack's memories return. Lily asks her friends to care for her children.

videos.title: The Sun Also Rises
videos.overview: The town says goodbye to a dear friend. Brie suffers a loss of her own. Mel and Jack discuss what should happen with their relationship.

videos.title: A Wedding, No Funeral and a Baby
videos.overview: Jack makes a momentous decision as Mel grapples with how to share surprising news. Doc is plagued with concern. Preacher meets with Paige's friend.

videos.title: Be My Baby
videos.overview: Mel seeks medical care, with a nervous Jack by her side. Hope's confusion puts Doc in a tough position. A new doctor joins the practice.

videos.title: Father Knows Best...?
videos.overview: Jack and Brie's father causes friction when he comes into town. An incident at work affects Mel. Doc gets to know his unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Grilled
videos.overview: Mel plans a dinner for Cameron to meet Jack, but plans go awry. Connie warns Lizzie to be careful with Denny. Preacher befriends his aikido teacher.

videos.title: Serious as A...
videos.overview: Hope's concussive symptoms continue, frustrating both her and Doc. Meanwhile, Mel asks Preacher to help her surprise a stubborn Jack.

videos.title: Mayday
videos.overview: After Hope and friends sew the costumes, Lizzie and Ricky rehearse for the Renaissance Fair. Brie and Mike team up to investigate who paid Brady's bond.

videos.title: All's Faire...
videos.overview: The Renaissance Fair kicks off. Mel worries about Jack after a familiar face triggers painful memories. Denny watches Lizzie and Ricky perform.

videos.title: Otherwise Engaged
videos.overview: Joey arrives with some shocking news that has Mel questioning her sister's judgment. Jack brainstorms a new revenue stream.

videos.title: Talk to Me
videos.overview: Mel plans a surprise for Joey but is distracted by her concern for Jack. Lizzie struggles with telling Doc what she saw in Denny's drawer.

videos.title: Bombshells
videos.overview: Mel deals with the aftermath of Jack's disappearance while also getting troubling news from Stacie. Mike and Brie continue their search for Calvin.

videos.title: Fire and Rain
videos.overview: Charmaine asks Jack for support at the baby shower. Mel has a tough conversation with Cassandra. Preacher worries about Christopher after their call.

videos.title: Once Again
videos.overview: Vernon and Hope argue about seeking in-home care, Mel confronts Cameron about his odd behavior, and Jack gets his glamping Airstream up and running.

videos.title: The Long Goodbye
videos.overview: Mel and Jack finally receive the results they've been waiting on. Lizzie organizes a send-off for Ricky before speaking to Denny about his secret.

videos.title: A Second Chance
videos.overview: Mel makes a tough decision. Jack draws a potential business investor. Preacher and Paige wonder if they're on the same page. A council meeting stuns Hope.

videos.title: Songbird
videos.overview: Doc and Cameron try to run the clinic together. Mel supports Ava through a personal dilemma. Jack confronts Charmaine. Brady seeks a second chance.

videos.title: Calculated Risk
videos.overview: Mel makes an exception for a former patient. Brie opens up to Brady. Preacher meets a charming firefighter. Jack goes mountain climbing with Denny.

videos.title: Never Gonna Be The Same
videos.overview: Doc confides in Denny. Hope's spa day takes a turn. A desperate Brady reaches out to Mike. On a camping trip, Mel and Jack learn more about each other.

videos.title: Trial by Fire
videos.overview: As danger closes in, Jack, Hope and other residents take action. A discovery puts Mel on edge. Brie sees a friendly face after a tense day in court.

videos.title: Heroes Rise
videos.overview: Mel and Jack race to bring Ava and Chloe to safety. As the crisis intensifies, Brady defies Preacher, while Hope proposes a plan to save Virgin River.

videos.title: From the Ashes
videos.overview: The devastation brings revelations and reconciliations as the community attempts to rebuild and lift each other up after the fires.

videos.title: Full Moon
videos.overview: After a girls' night, Mel struggles to let go of her fears. Kaia opens up to Preacher. Mike and Brady set aside their differences to nab a criminal.

videos.title: Angel's Peak
videos.overview: Mel and Jack explore other possibilities for their future. Brady follows Melissa and lands in an awkward position. Romance is in the air at the clinic.

videos.title: Labor Day
videos.overview: Tensions escalate as Brady, Jack and Mike get caught in the crosshairs of an illicit scheme. More surprises emerge for Mel, Denny and Preacher.

videos.title: The More the Merrier
videos.overview: As the holidays get underway, visiting relatives bring drama to town. Mel and Jack try to track down the author of the mysterious letters to her mother.

videos.title: Father Christmas
videos.overview: Shocking news and unexpected gifts are in store on Christmas Eve as couples and families come together despite their differences.

videos.title: Hope Springs Eternal
videos.overview: Mel wants to honor her mom at the wedding and asks for Everett's help. Brady and Lark celebrate his settlement. Preacher's trial begins with a twist.

videos.title: The Broken Places
videos.overview: Everett reveals the story of how he met Mel's mother. Preacher faces a life-changing choice. The sewing circle plays matchmaker for Muriel.

videos.title: The Jury's Out
videos.overview: A familiar face returns to town with surprising news. Preacher awaits his fate. Mel meets with Doc to discuss her new plan. Brady puts Lark on the spot.

videos.title: Brothers & Sisters
videos.overview: Old tensions and buried feelings emerge when Mel and Jack's pre-wedding parties get a little rowdy. Lizzie and Denny are uncertain about their future.

videos.title: Love Story
videos.overview: Mel and Jack's fathers meet for brunch, leaving Everett with second thoughts. Doc makes a heroic move. A routine prison visit raises Brie's suspicions.

videos.title: Ghosts
videos.overview: After Mel and Jack run into a paperwork glitch, Jack visits Mandy — and admits a past mistake. Kaia knows Brady's secret. An old nemesis makes threats.

videos.title: I Climbed a Mountain and I Turned Around
videos.overview: Everett takes Mel to a place that's dear to his heart. Brie confesses to Jack after helping Charmaine. Brady's past haunts him, and Mel lashes out at Doc.

videos.title: Going Overboard
videos.overview: Hope directs the rehearsal and helps Jack patch up a spat. Brie and Mike reach a major milestone. Everett sets out to finish his heartfelt gift.

videos.title: Prelude to a Kiss
videos.overview: Jack and Mel's wedding day gets off to an emotional start. The truth comes out about Doc and Everett. Hope's temper could cause trouble for Doc.

videos.title: The Big Day
videos.overview: While their guests wait, Mel confesses her fears to Jack. Brady has a rude awakening, Mike and Brie have a serious moment — and Doc gets stunning news.

videos.title: The Afterglow
videos.overview: Mel and Jack weigh Marley's offer — and debate honeymoon destinations — as they begin married life together. Brie and Mike confront their issues.

videos.title: Beautiful Child
videos.overview: Marley assesses Jack's fatherhood potential. Doc struggles to hold back when a patient seeks help. Brady searches for Lark — and his money.

videos.title: The Match
videos.overview: Mel, Jack and Marley examine more than the wares at a local flea market. Hope's campaign against Grace Valley hits a snag at a town hall meeting.

videos.title: Pipe Dreams
videos.overview: Jack and Mel prepare their unfinished home for a visit from a social worker. Brie does Brady a friendly favor. Doc takes a swing at something new.

videos.title: Always Anywhere Forever
videos.overview: Mel makes an unexpectedly dangerous house call. The sewing circle shares their concerns with Kaia. Hope and Doc get high on memories of young love.

videos.title: No Regrets
videos.overview: An abrupt arrival threatens to upend Mel and Jack's plans. Kaia and Brady team up to tackle a wildfire. Preacher makes an ambitious proposal.

videos.title: It Takes A Village
videos.overview: Doc faces off with Dr. Hayes at a pivotal medical board hearing. A baby shower pushes Lizzie to her breaking point. Clay opens up about his past.

videos.title: Back In The Saddle
videos.overview: Clay tries to buck his troubles by entering a high-stakes rodeo competition. Brie tracks an unlikely new lead in the search for Charmaine.

videos.title: La Luna De Miel
videos.overview: Eager to escape their worries, Mel and Jack embark on their honeymoon, where a freewheeling day trip takes a surprising turn.

videos.title: David and Goliath
videos.overview: The town gathers for a festive Founder's Day, where Hope stages a last-ditch effort to preserve Virgin River. Mel and Jack receive life-changing news.
